text:
Type: adjustable nickel-plated desk lamp
Use: focused task light for reading and working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: industrial, retro, modern
Materials: nickel-plated steel dome shade, spring-balanced metal arm, round metal base, black cord
Colors: polished silver nickel, black
Shape: rounded dome shade with a small pull knob on a jointed scissor arm with springs, round heavy base, mechanical architect look, compact
Feel: practical, crafted, focused, vintage
Goes with: white or dark wood desks, black accents, grey walls; industrial, modern or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: FORS
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
